english.title: Receive / arrange to receive / remove / dispose etc. article for use in immigration crime
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse

(A)_[received or arranged to receive a relevant article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..), from a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_
(B)_[removed or disposed of a relevant article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..) for the benefit of a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),]_
(C)_[assisted a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to remove or dispose of a relevant article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..),]_

knowing or suspecting at the time of doing so that the article had been, was being or was to be used by yourself or another person in connection with an offence under section 24 or 25 of the Immigration Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(1), 2) and (8) of the Border Security, Asylum and Immigration Act 2025.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence applies to things done inside or outside the United Kingdom - see section 20.
